tagline: An independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company focused on the Delaware Basin.
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is the primary growth driver in shale exploration and production, directly influencing future output and capacity in the Delaware Basin.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on drilling, completions, and fixed assets.
kpis.description: Total capex reached $2.3B in 2025, up from $1.8B in 2024, driven by acquisitions and increased activity in the Delaware Basin.
kpis.signal: Capex rising sharply to support production growth

kpis.name: Oil Equivalent Production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of oil, gas, and condensates produced, converted to barrels of oil equivalent.
kpis.description: Oil equivalent production reached 285.6 MMBoe in 2025, up 38.0 MMBoe from 2024 (247.6 MMBoe).
kpis.signal: Significant production growth driven by acquisitions

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached $4.0B in 2025, up $1.2B from 2024 ($2.8B), driven by higher production and gas prices.
kpis.signal: Strong cash flow growth despite lower oil prices

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income totaled $1.7B in 2025, up $596 million from 2024 ($1.1B).
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth reflecting positive price mix impact

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share held.
kpis.description: The quarterly dividend was increased to $0.22 per share in February 2025, up from $0.21 previously.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase reflecting balance sheet strength and cash flow

kpis.name: Available Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Sum of available cash and unused commitments on the revolving credit facility.
kpis.description: Total liquidity of $2.1B as of December 31, 2025, comprising $114M in cash and $2.0B in available credit capacity.
kpis.signal: Solid liquidity despite acquisitions and debt repayments

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $7.645B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $2.452B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.22 for the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.682B for the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 39.7% for the last year.

kpis.name: Average Realized Natural Gas Price
kpis.explanation: Average price realized by the company for natural gas sold.
kpis.description: The average realized gas price reached $2.47/Mcf in 2025, up 41% from $1.75/Mcf in 2024.

kpis.name: Average Realized Oil Price
kpis.explanation: Average price realized by the company for crude oil sold.
kpis.description: The average realized oil price was $64.35/barrel in 2025, down 13% from $74.22/barrel in 2024.
kpis.signal: Oil prices declined in 2025 despite sustained global demand

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Used to assess the company's ability to generate earnings per share, serving as the basis for calculating Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Failure or Delay of Devon Merger
risks.summary: The merger with Devon could fail or be delayed, resulting in high costs, loss of confidence, and potentially payment of a termination fee.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned first and repeated multiple times. Language is strong (may not be completed at all). The merger is a strategic priority, and its failure would have existential consequences.

risks.title: Business Disruption During Merger
risks.summary: Uncertainty related to the merger may cause employees, customers, and suppliers to distance themselves, disrupting the company's day-to-day operations.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned multiple times with concerning language (disruptions, uncertainty, adversely affect). Recurring risk during the merger period. Direct impact on employee and business partner retention.

risks.title: Difficult Integration of Both Companies
risks.summary: Combining Coterra and Devon operations could fail to generate expected synergies, with higher-than-anticipated integration costs.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with serious consequences (loss of key employees, high costs, delays). Strong language: could result in, unforeseen expenses.

risks.title: Commodity Price Decline
risks.summary: A prolonged decline in oil, gas, or NGL prices could drastically reduce revenues, reserves, and the ability to invest.
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a fundamental risk in the Business and Operational Risks section. Very strong language (material adverse impact, substantial or extended decline). Historical volatility highlighted.

risks.title: Merger-Related Litigation
risks.summary: Lawsuits could be filed against Coterra or Devon, delaying or blocking the merger and resulting in significant legal fees.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of litigation risks (class actions, derivative actions). Cautious but serious language (substantial costs, injunction). New risk related to the merger announcement.

risks.title: High Merger-Related Costs
risks.summary: Coterra must bear significant merger expenses whether or not the deal closes, weighing on cash and net income.
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of significant costs (financial advisors, legal fees, employee-related expenses). Even if the merger fails, these costs are incurred. Direct impact on cash.

risks.title: Uncertainty on Future Dividends
risks.summary: After the merger, dividends are no longer guaranteed and will depend on the new board's policy, which may concern shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned with cautious language (uncertain, discretion of the Board). Less intense than others, but important for income-focused investors.

ai_positioning.summary: CTRA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
